desc: Minnefest for de døde med rekviemmesse. Graver pyntes med blomster og lys.
notes: Celebrated since the 900s. SNL's primstav table confirms this was a carved merkedag (symbol: 'Kors, tre, strek' — cross, tree, line), which is worth recording since not every church calendar date made it onto a physical stave (see 1-12 Midtvinter, researched but excluded for exactly this reason). Merged into FIXED/ICONS in all three HTML files 2026-08-18.
